@pytest.mark.req("INST-05")
def test_docs_check_logged_before_hook_was_written():
    """The docs check comes earlier in the append-only log than the entry that wrote
    log_event.py: 'before writing the hook' really happened first."""
    text, m = section()
    hook_entry = re.search(r"^## .*log_event\.py", text, re.M)
    assert hook_entry and m.start() < hook_entry.start()

tests.docstring:
A record has exactly {ts, event, session_id, phase, payload}, and ts is ISO 8601 with a
timezone offset (local tz, not naive).
tests.source:
@pytest.mark.req("INST-02", "INST-08")
def test_record_has_exact_schema_and_local_iso_ts(project):
    """A record has exactly {ts, event, session_id, phase, payload}, and ts is ISO 8601 with a
    timezone offset (local tz, not naive)."""
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("SessionStart", source="startup")))
    [rec] = events(project)
    assert set(rec) == {"ts", "event", "session_id", "phase", "payload"}
    ts = datetime.fromisoformat(rec["ts"])
    assert ts.tzinfo is not None
    assert ts.utcoffset() == datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset()
    assert rec["event"] == "SessionStart" and rec["session_id"] == "sess-1"
    assert rec["phase"] == "P0:test"

@pytest.mark.req("INST-02", "INST-08")
def test_stop_falls_back_to_last_assistant_text_in_transcript(project, tmp_path):
    """With no last_assistant_message, Stop takes the text of the LAST assistant entry in
    transcript_path. It ignores tool_use blocks, user entries, and blank or corrupt lines."""
    t = write_transcript(tmp_path / "t.jsonl", [
        {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": "q1"}},
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "old answer"}]}},
        {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": "q2"}},
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "new "},
                                                      {"type": "tool_use", "name": "Bash"},
                                                      {"type": "text", "text": "answer"}]}},
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "name": "Read"}]}},
    ])
    with open(t, "a") as f:
        f.write("{not json\n\n")
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("Stop", transcript_path=str(t))))
    assert events(project)[0]["payload"] == {"response_excerpt": "new \nanswer"}

@pytest.mark.req("INST-02")
def test_phase_change_takes_effect_on_next_event(project):
    """.phase is read on every event, so editing it retags later events without a restart."""
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="a")))
    (project / ".phase").write_text("P1:build")
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="b")))
    assert [e["phase"] for e in events(project)] == ["P0:test", "P1:build"]

@pytest.mark.req("INST-04")
def test_later_copy_replaces_earlier_with_superset(project, tmp_path):
    """A PreCompact copy followed by a SessionEnd copy of the grown transcript leaves the latest
    (superset) contents in one file per session."""
    t = write_transcript(tmp_path / "t.jsonl", [{"n": 1}])
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("PreCompact", transcript_path=str(t), trigger="auto")))
    write_transcript(t, [{"n": 1}, {"n": 2}])
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("SessionEnd", transcript_path=str(t), reason="other")))
    files = list((project / "raw_logs" / "transcripts").iterdir())
    assert [f.name for f in files] == ["sess-1.jsonl"]
    assert files[0].read_bytes() == t.read_bytes()

@pytest.mark.req("INST-04")
def test_session_id_is_sanitized_into_filename(project, tmp_path):
    """A session_id containing path separators can't write outside raw_logs/transcripts/."""
    t = write_transcript(tmp_path / "t.jsonl", [{"n": 1}])
    ok(run_hook(project, sample("SessionEnd", transcript_path=str(t), reason="other",
                                session_id="../../evil")))
    assert [f.name for f in (project / "raw_logs" / "transcripts").iterdir()] == ["______evil.jsonl"]
    assert not (project.parent / "evil.jsonl").exists()

Each pattern class in INST-09 (emails, sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/Bearer tokens, /Users and
/home paths) is replaced with its placeholder. The text around it is unchanged.
tests.source:
@pytest.mark.req("INST-09")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,expected", [
    ("mail me@example.com now", "mail [EMAIL] now"),
    ("a.b+tag@sub.uni.edu", "[EMAIL]"),
    ("key sk-ant-api03-AbC123_def-456ghiJKL789 end", f"key {TOKEN} end"),
    ("sk-proj-abcdefghijklmnop1234", TOKEN),
    ("ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789", TOKEN),
    ("github_pat_11ABCDEFG0123456789_abcdefghijklmnop", TOKEN),
    ("Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.payload.sig", f"Authorization: {TOKEN}"),
    ("/Users/someone/Desktop/CS 4005/Project 2", "~/Desktop/CS 4005/Project 2"),
    ("/home/bob/.ssh/id_rsa", "~/.ssh/id_rsa"),
    ("cd '/Users/alice' && ls", "cd '~' && ls"),
    ("file:///Users/alice/x.html", "file://~/x.html"),
])
def test_redacts_each_secret_class(raw, expected):
    """Each pattern class in INST-09 (emails, sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/Bearer tokens, /Users and
    /home paths) is replaced with its placeholder. The text around it is unchanged."""
    assert redact(raw) == expected

    ("/home/bob/.ssh/id_rsa", "~/.ssh/id_rsa"),
    ("cd '/Users/alice' && ls", "cd '~' && ls"),
    ("file:///Users/alice/x.html", "file://~/x.html"),
])
def test_redacts_each_secret_class(raw, expected):
    """Each pattern class in INST-09 (emails, sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/Bearer tokens, /Users and
    /home paths) is replaced with its placeholder. The text around it is unchanged."""
    assert redact(raw) == expected

@pytest.mark.req("INST-09")
def test_stop_excerpt_redacts_before_truncating(tmp_path):
    """A token straddling the 1,000-char cut is redacted, not left as a partial key that's too
    short to match."""
    # The space matters: the sk- pattern requires a word boundary, so "task-management-…" is not
    # redacted (see test_leaves_lookalikes_alone). The redacted token then spans chars 990-1005.
    msg = "x" * 989 + " sk-ant-api03-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV"
    run_hook(tmp_path, {"hook_event_name": "Stop", "session_id": "s", "last_assistant_message": msg})
    excerpt = events(tmp_path)[0]["payload"]["response_excerpt"]
    assert "sk-ant" not in excerpt and excerpt.endswith("[REDACTED_")

@pytest.mark.req("INST-07")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
def test_phase_from_first_req_prefix_and_kind_default(runfile):
    """phase comes from the first req ID's area (DATA -> P1, INST -> P0, TOK -> P6),
    not from .phase. With no req, phase is "untagged". kind defaults to unit."""
    data, tests = runfile
    assert (tests["test_pass"]["req_ids"], tests["test_pass"]["phase"]) == (["DATA-03"], "P1")
    assert (tests["test_fail"]["req_ids"], tests["test_fail"]["phase"]) == (["INST-01", "VAL-02"], "P0")
    assert tests["test_skip"]["phase"] == "P6"
    assert (tests["test_untagged"]["req_ids"], tests["test_untagged"]["phase"]) == ([], "untagged")
    assert tests["test_pass"]["kind"] == "property"
    assert tests["test_fail"]["kind"] == "unit"
    assert data["current_phase"] == "untagged"  # no .phase in the pytester project

@pytest.mark.req("INST-07")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
def test_messages_docstrings_and_source_captured(runfile):
    """failure_message holds the assertion text, skip reason, or setup error. docstring and
    source come from the test function. Passing tests have an empty message."""
    _, tests = runfile
    assert "boom-marker" in tests["test_fail"]["failure_message"]
    assert "skip-reason-marker" in tests["test_skip"]["failure_message"]
    assert "setup-broke-marker" in tests["test_error"]["failure_message"]
    assert tests["test_pass"]["failure_message"] == ""
    assert tests["test_pass"]["docstring"] == "Proves the passing path."
    assert tests["test_fail"]["source"].startswith('@pytest.mark.req("INST-01", "VAL-02")')
    assert "def test_fail():" in tests["test_fail"]["source"]

The exact command string from settings.json, run through a shell from a project dir
whose path contains spaces (like the real one), reaches the hook and logs the event.
tests.source:
@pytest.mark.req("INST-01")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("event", EVENTS)
def test_registered_command_runs_from_path_with_spaces(tmp_path, event):
    """The exact command string from settings.json, run through a shell from a project dir
    whose path contains spaces (like the real one), reaches the hook and logs the event."""
    project = tmp_path / "proj with spaces"
    (project / ".claude" / "hooks").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy(HOOK, project / ".claude" / "hooks" / "log_event.py")
    cmd = _commands(event)[0]["command"]
    env = {**os.environ, "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": str(project)}
    stdin = json.dumps({"hook_event_name": event, "session_id": "s", "transcript_path": "",
                        "last_assistant_message": "x"})
    proc = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", "-c", cmd], input=stdin, text=True,
                          capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=30)
    assert proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == ""
    assert [e["event"] for e in events(project)] == [event]
